title: Appliance Repair Technician Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Facility Appliance Repair: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Appliance Repair Technician Sign-Off Form covers commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation. The facility appliance service coordinator records Facility Appliance Repair performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Appliance Repair Technician Sign-Off Form keeps Facility Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the facility appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Technician Sign-Off Form at shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position. Document commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation identity before Facility Appliance Repair begins. Compare commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation findings with stated Facility Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Facility Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance service supervisor. For Appliance Repair Technician Sign-Off Form, confirm requirements for Facility Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance service supervisor to review Facility Appliance Repair conditions beyond the facility appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Provider, customer, and service record
sections.guidance: For Facility Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position, and the linked commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, make, model, serial, and appliance type
Reported symptom, error code, duty cycle, and user impact

sections.title: Performed scope and verification results
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Appliance Repair facts for commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Facility Appliance Repair completion checks
items: Power, gas, water, drain, vent, and connection condition
Door, latch, seal, interlock, and enclosure condition
Motor, pump, fan, heater, sensor, and control behavior
Leak, drainage, airflow, temperature, and cycle result
Anchorage, leveling, clearance, and adjacent property condition
Full representative operating cycle after repair

sections.title: Completion limitation, status, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Facility Appliance Repair conditions; have facility appliance service coordinator assign the next Facility Appliance Repair owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, refrigerant, water, or combustion hazard
Safe full-cycle test cannot be completed
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, incompatible part, or unsafe operating result remains. Retain the available Facility Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation scope to facility appliance service coordinator.
